g.text: 4 pixel inputs + bias rail; each signed weight = conductance pair (RP to column cp, RN to column cn)
OPP/OPN: transimpedance amplifiers hold cp, cn at virtual ground: v(tp) = -Rf*I+, v(tn) = -Rf*I-
OPD: difference amplifier, S = v(tn) - v(tp) = Rf*(I+ - I-). Expected S = -0.4393 V (Stage A hand calculation)
measurement interface: DC simulation / probe on S
